verdict.rationale: Team admins can create organization-wide rules in Bugbot Automations, and the GitHub app can be scoped to all or selected repositories, which gives some org-level defaults and repo scoping. Overrides, however, appear to live in per-repo `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files rather than a central console. Missing for 10: documented central exception/override management (per-repo opt-outs or rule exemptions from one place), detail on how org rules propagate across hundreds of repos, admin-level default settings beyond rules, and independent corroboration of org-scale rollout.
